actions.desc: The mephit exhales a cloud of fog  creating a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on the mephit. The fog is heavily obscured to non-mephits. The fog cloud is immobile  spreads around corners  and remains for 10 minutes or until dispersed by a strong wind.
